limiter.title: Output Limiter
limiter.description: Limits the mixed output without boosting quiet audio.

hints.threshold: Soft limiting begins above this input level.
hints.target: Output sample-peak ceiling. Lowering it also lowers threshold if needed.
hints.release: Longer release restores volume more gradually.
hints.knee: 0%: hard ceiling at target. Higher values bend more gently from threshold.

limiter.active: Limiter active on the mixed output

empty.title: No tabs being monitored
empty.hint: Click "Register Tab" to start monitoring audio

autoFocus.title: Auto-focus active tab
autoFocus.description: Focuses a monitored tab whenever it becomes active.
